atoms.text: Joe, Allie, Max and Grace all love reading books. This bar chart shows how many books they’ve each read this year.

instruction.text: Which child has read the most? Put the children in order from most to least.
Answer the following questions using the bar chart.

atoms.a: How many more books has Grace read than Max?
What is the difference between the number of books read by the child who read the most and the child who read the least?
Together, how many books have Joe and Allie read?
atoms.sound: Together, how many books have Joe and Allie red?

atoms.a: What is the total number of books the children have read?

instruction.text: Joe, Allie, Max and Grace also all play football together. Answer the following questions using this bar chart which shows how many goals they’ve each scored this year.

atoms.a: Who has scored an equal number of goals?
What is the difference between the child who scored the most goals and the one who scored the least?
Together, how many goals have Grace and Max scored?
What is the total number of goals the children have scored?
